title: 一边...一边...
structure: Subject + 一边 + action 1 + 一边 + action 2
explanation: Shows two actions happening at the same time.
exampleChinese: 他一边听音乐，一边做作业。
exampleEnglish: He listens to music while doing homework.

title: 不仅...而且...
structure: Subject + 不仅 + quality/action + 而且 + quality/action
explanation: Connects two positive facts, with the second often stronger.
exampleChinese: 她不仅会说中文，而且写得很好。
exampleEnglish: She can not only speak Chinese, but also write it well.

title: 虽然...但是...
structure: 虽然 + situation, 但是 + result
explanation: Introduces contrast between a fact and an unexpected result.
exampleChinese: 虽然今天很累，但是我还要复习。
exampleEnglish: Although I am tired today, I still need to review.

title: 只要...就...
explanation: Means that one sufficient condition will produce a result.
exampleChinese: 只要你坚持练习，就会进步。
exampleEnglish: As long as you keep practicing, you will improve.

title: 只有...才...
structure: 只有 + necessary condition + 才 + result
explanation: Shows that a result happens only under a necessary condition.
exampleChinese: 只有多听多说，才可以提高口语。
exampleEnglish: Only by listening and speaking more can you improve speaking.

title: 越...越...
explanation: Shows that one change increases together with another.
exampleChinese: 中文越学越有意思。
exampleEnglish: The more I study Chinese, the more interesting it becomes.

title: 越来越...
explanation: Describes something becoming more and more a certain way.
exampleChinese: 我的听力越来越好了。
exampleEnglish: My listening is getting better and better.

title: 把字句
explanation: Highlights what happens to a definite object.
exampleChinese: 请把这篇文章读一遍。
exampleEnglish: Please read this article once.

title: 被字句
explanation: Expresses passive meaning, often when the object is affected.
exampleChinese: 我的手机被弟弟拿走了。
exampleEnglish: My phone was taken away by my younger brother.

title: 是...的
structure: Subject + 是 + detail + verb + 的
explanation: Emphasizes details such as time, place, or manner of a past action.
exampleChinese: 我是昨天到北京的。
exampleEnglish: It was yesterday that I arrived in Beijing.

title: 差点儿
explanation: Means something almost happened.
exampleChinese: 我差点儿忘了今天的考试。
exampleEnglish: I almost forgot today's exam.

title: 除了...以外
explanation: Means besides or except, depending on context.
exampleChinese: 除了词汇以外，语法也很重要。
exampleEnglish: Besides vocabulary, grammar is also important.

title: 连...都/也...
structure: 连 + surprising item + 都/也 + result
explanation: Emphasizes an extreme or surprising example.
exampleChinese: 这个字很难，连老师都写错了。
exampleEnglish: This character is so hard that even the teacher wrote it wrong.

title: 为了
explanation: Introduces the purpose of an action.
exampleChinese: 为了通过HSK考试，他每天学习两个小时。
exampleEnglish: To pass the HSK exam, he studies two hours every day.

title: 由于
explanation: Gives a formal reason or cause.
exampleChinese: 由于天气不好，比赛取消了。
exampleEnglish: Because the weather was bad, the match was cancelled.

title: 因此
explanation: Means therefore; connects cause and result.
exampleChinese: 他准备得很充分，因此考得不错。
exampleEnglish: He prepared very well, therefore he did well on the test.

title: 既然...就...
structure: 既然 + known fact + 就 + suggestion/result
explanation: Means since a fact is true, a result or decision follows.
exampleChinese: 既然你已经报名了，就认真准备吧。
exampleEnglish: Since you have already registered, prepare seriously.

title: 即使...也...
explanation: Means even if; result remains unchanged under a condition.
exampleChinese: 即使很忙，我也会复习生词。
exampleEnglish: Even if I am busy, I will review new words.

title: 宁可...也不...
structure: 宁可 + choice A + 也不 + choice B
explanation: Shows preference for one choice over another.
exampleChinese: 我宁可早起，也不想迟到。
exampleEnglish: I would rather get up early than be late.

title: 难道...吗
explanation: A rhetorical question expressing surprise or disagreement.
exampleChinese: 难道你不想提高中文水平吗？
exampleEnglish: Don't you want to improve your Chinese level?

title: 怪不得
structure: Reason or discovery + 怪不得 + result
explanation: Means no wonder after learning a reason.
exampleChinese: 他每天练习，怪不得说得这么流利。
exampleEnglish: He practices every day; no wonder he speaks so fluently.

title: 把...当作...
structure: Subject + 把 + A + 当作 + B
explanation: Means to treat or regard A as B.
exampleChinese: 她把学习中文当作一种爱好。
exampleEnglish: She treats studying Chinese as a hobby.

title: 对...来说
explanation: Means from someone's perspective.
exampleChinese: 对我来说，听力最难。
exampleEnglish: For me, listening is the hardest.

title: 关于
explanation: Introduces the topic being discussed.
exampleChinese: 关于这道题，我还有一个问题。
exampleEnglish: Regarding this question, I still have one question.

title: 按照
explanation: Means according to a rule, plan, or instruction.
exampleChinese: 请按照要求完成练习。
exampleEnglish: Please complete the exercise according to the requirements.

title: 通过
explanation: Means through or by means of.
exampleChinese: 通过阅读，我学到了很多词语。
exampleEnglish: Through reading, I learned many words.

title: 一...就...
structure: Subject + 一 + action 1 + 就 + action 2
explanation: Shows one action happening immediately after another.
exampleChinese: 我一回家就开始复习。
exampleEnglish: As soon as I got home, I started reviewing.

title: 刚...就...
explanation: Means something happened just after another action.
exampleChinese: 我刚坐下，老师就来了。
exampleEnglish: I had just sat down when the teacher arrived.

title: 差不多
explanation: Means almost, nearly, or about the same.
exampleChinese: 这些题我差不多都会做。
exampleEnglish: I can do almost all of these questions.

title: 无论...都...
explanation: Means no matter what condition, the result remains the same.
exampleChinese: 无论考试难不难，我都要认真准备。
exampleEnglish: No matter whether the exam is difficult, I will prepare seriously.
